title: Experts disagree on Stop hook payload background_tasks field
context:
Chief architect: Ruled by the chief, settled by the run evidence and by the cross-provider rule: read the payload field when it is there, and when it is missing, empty or not a list, fall back to the stage ledger. A missing field never means no agent is running. This is the same single predicate ruled on deferCompletionForBackgroundStage.

Target: Stop hook payload background_tasks field
- integration-architect: the turn-end backstop must read background_tasks from the Stop payload and defer judging, sealing cost.json and signing receipt.json while any task belongs to a paqad stage agent of the open change
- integration-architect: when background_tasks is missing or not an array (older Claude Code or another adapter), the backstop must fall back to the stage ledger saying a stage is running, and must never treat a missing field as no agent running
